profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that describes itself as a commercial-stage developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4. Its site states that it is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800, and that its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries. The company presents its WeRide One platform as a universal autonomous driving technology platform, alongside a self-developed foundational toolchain and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data.

WeRide says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi, and describes itself as a pioneer in large-scale commercial deployment of autonomous driving. It also states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. These are the company's own characterizations of its position and scale.

The record held for the company lists no litigation and no tracked products or MCP servers. Its registration details include CIK 0001867729 and the alias WERIDE INC-ADR.
